description:
## Goal
Move the private `Fetcher::Action` enum out of `src/vug/fetcher.cr` into a dedicated file. Rename it to avoid collision with the existing `FetchAction` namespace in `src/vug/fetch_types.cr`.

## Why (SRP + clarity)
The `Action` enum currently sits in `fetcher.cr` next to the loop that consumes it. Two distinct "action" concepts exist in the codebase:
- `FetchAction::Follow` / `FetchAction::Deny` in `fetch_types.cr` — what the redirect handler decides
- `Fetcher::Action` (in `fetcher.cr`) — what the fetch loop should do next

The shared word "action" causes confusion: `Fetcher::Action::Redirect` is a *loop control* decision, not a *redirect* decision. Putting the loop enum in its own file and giving it a more distinct name (`LoopAction` is a candidate) makes the dispatch site readable at a glance.

## Approach
1. Create `src/vug/loop_action.cr`.
2. Move the `enum Action` block (lines 35-40 of `fetcher.cr`) to the new file. Rename to `LoopAction` (final name to be confirmed during implementation; keep distinct from `FetchAction`).
3. Update all references inside `fetcher.cr`:
   - `Action::Redirect` -> `LoopAction::Redirect` (and the other three)
   - Parameter/return types `Action` -> `LoopAction`
4. Re-export from `src/vug.cr`.

## Acceptance
- The enum lives in `src/vug/loop_action.cr` with a name distinct from `FetchAction`.
- No `Fetcher::Action` reference remains anywhere in the codebase.
- All fetcher specs pass.
- `crystal tool format` and `ameba` are clean.

## Notes
- This ticket touches the type signature of `apply_action`, `handle_result_action`, `fetch_result_uri`, `gray_placeholder_uri`. All four will need updating.
- Coordinate with `vugcr-mri` (typed struct for tuple returns) since the struct can hold a `LoopAction` rather than `Action`.
title: Extract fetch-loop Action enum to its own file
